title: How to choose a Srinagar heritage day
description: An old-city walk, a museum visit and an artisan appointment each deserve their own time.

copy.original: For architecture and everyday city life, request a focused route around Khanqah-e-Moula, Zaina Kadal, Maharaj Gunj and Jamia Masjid / Nowhatta. A guide can adjust direction, walking length and vehicle links around your preferences and local conditions.
copy.value: For architecture and everyday city life, request a focused route around Khanqah-e-Moula, Zaina Kadal, Maharaj Gunj and Jamia Masjid / Nowhatta. A guide can adjust direction, walking length and vehicle links around your preferences and local conditions.

copy.original: The Sri Pratap Singh Museum at Lal Mandi is a separate stop from the old-city walking circuit. Check opening and gallery access for your date, and choose a museum-and-craft day if collections and making interest you most. Do not assume opening hours or tickets from a generic itinerary.

copy.original: A carpet loom, pashmina weaving, sozni embroidery, papier-mâché painting or woodcraft visit depends on a willing host. Agree the visit fee and whether it is a demonstration, workshop or shopping appointment. Purchases are optional; ask for written material, origin and delivery information when buying.

copy.original: These are living religious places. Ask before entering, follow clothing and shoe rules, and request permission for photographs. Prayer, observances and local restrictions can change access. A multi-faith route is best planned as a separate day with steps and visiting permissions checked.
